expectations.text: Acceptance criteria use user-observable EARS format
expectations.evidence: All acceptance criteria use EARS patterns with user-observable outcomes, e.g. "WHEN I open the settings page THEN I SHALL see a clear option to choose between light and dark appearance" and "IF I change appearance on the settings page THEN I SHALL see my choice reflected consistently across all sections of that page".

expectations.text: No API endpoints or database schemas in acceptance criteria
expectations.evidence: Acceptance criteria describe only user-visible behavior (appearance options, color scheme changes, readability) with no mention of APIs, databases, configuration flags, or other implementation details.

expectations.text: Includes As a / I want / so that structure
expectations.evidence: User Story section includes: "As a Accessibility-Conscious Professional", "I want to switch the settings page to a dark appearance", and "so that I can work comfortably in dim lighting and reduce eye strain without leaving the settings area".
